text:
Situation: Scopolamine transdermal system is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory provides 10.4 days at Corvale East, 14.8 days at Corvale General, and 17 days at Corvale Lakeside.

Why (FDA record): A previous FDA posting for Padagis US LLC scopolamine transdermal system was marked "To Be Discontinued" with an initial posting date of 2025-11-03. FDA's shortage list shows scopolamine is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is limited but available from multiple manufacturers not on the shortage list. Padagis discontinuation reduces one source. Alternate manufacturers have adequate regulatory standing.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC as primary alternate source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Baxter Healthcare Corporation as secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Ingenus Pharmaceuticals, LLC as tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to monitor Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. and Rhodes Pharmaceuticals LLC availability; requires buyer approval.
5. Pharmacy director to review allocation across Corvale sites weekly; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
